valid_quote: timestamp ordered; finite Bid/Ask; Ask>=Bid; crossed quotes cannot fill; zero-spread quote may exist in data but receives no artificial price advantage beyond its observed quote

CENTRAL.signal_to_entry_latency: first valid executable quote strictly after signal availability
CENTRAL.stop_target_fill: first actually executable side-specific quote after threshold event

CONSERVATIVE.signal_to_entry_latency: skip first valid executable quote after signal and use the next valid quote
CONSERVATIVE.stop_target_fill: skip first valid quote after exit trigger and use next valid quote plus one adverse point

SEVERE.signal_to_entry_latency: skip first two valid executable quotes after signal and use third valid quote
SEVERE.stop_target_fill: skip first two valid quotes after exit trigger and use third valid quote plus two adverse points

SLIPPAGE_UP.overlay: add one additional adverse point to every fill beyond selected execution profile

LATENCY_UP.overlay: skip one additional valid quote event at each entry/exit trigger beyond selected execution profile

RANDOM_EXECUTION_FAILURES.overlay: deterministically suppress 1 percent of otherwise eligible new entries using SHA256(trade_candidate_id) mapped to [0,1); no reseeding by result

REMOVE_BEST_TRADES_DIAGNOSTIC.overlay: post-development diagnostic only; remove top 1 percent trades by R after primary Gate A metrics; never used for selection rescue

COST_X1_5.overlay: multiply canonical explicit commission/fee component by 1.5; observed Bid/Ask spread remains observed, not multiplied

COST_X2.overlay: multiply canonical explicit commission/fee component by 2.0; observed Bid/Ask spread remains observed, not multiplied

hard_rules: SL first if SL and TP become ambiguous at same observable event
gap fill at first price actually executable under selected latency profile
